messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: kvcache-eviction-rate > 5% in eu-west-1 for 12m. Pager fired to eng-oncall primary. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/kv-evict-2469998888 :rotating_light:

sara: i'm primary on this shift — seeing 5xx increase + tail latency on embeddings encode path. started scaling kv-evictor and disabled prefetch for the affected pool. collecting logs now. no customer-facing timeout pages yet but CS flagged slow responses for a couple of beta customers.

devin: i'm secondary, standing by. i can take bridge if primary needs a break. FYI batch-job `daily-embeding-hydra` kicked off ~02:14 UTC which aligns w/ spike.

maria: customer impact tracker: CS-2312 (enterprise search) reported 30s response times, CS-2314 (doc-summarize) saw timeouts. both in eu-west. I've opened a support sticky and added customers to incident notes.

sara: mitigations in progress:
- scaled kv-evictor from 3 -> 6 replicas
- toggled prefetch to `off` for eu-west pool
- initiating prefix cache flush on nodes 5-8
- applying a temporary soft-limit for large batch encode requests (see command below)

Commands run:```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/kv-evictor --replicas=6
# flush prefix cache on node set
/opt/redwood/bin/kvctl flush-prefix --nodes=5,6,7,8 --pool=eu-west
# add temporary rate-limit for batch encoders
redwoodctl policies create --name temp-eu-batch-limit --scope embeddings --limit "500r/m" --duration 30m
```

devin: good. i added a temporary routing rule to divert embeddings > 512 tokens to fallback-model-small in eu-west, to reduce pressure on main pool. routing rule id: RR-7743.

sam: runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/kv-eviction - step 4 explains when to toggle prefetch and step 7 has safe scale thresholds. if scaling doesn't help, follow rollback and model-fallback section.

maria: note on escalation: if error-rate > 8% or customer timeouts escalate to >5 customers, page eng-sre and product-SRE pager. escalation path in runbook.

sara: coverage note — there's a coverage gap in the eu-west night window (02:00-05:00 UTC) where we usually only have one oncall. devin, can you confirm if you can stay on longer? ops-rotation, can we get a volunteer?

devin: I can extend to 05:30 UTC if needed. otherwise we should spin up a hot backup pager from on-call rotations.

ops-rotation: pinged rotation volunteers, @mike and @leah are on-call backup and available for the 03:00-06:00 UTC window.

sara: handoff plan (short):
- active alerts: kvcache-evict-rate > 5% (eu-west) + related 5xx on embeddings service
- mitigations done/in-progress: scale (6/6), prefetch off (done), prefix flush (in progress), routing fallback enabled (done)
- next actions for next oncall: watch error-rate for 30m, confirm prefix flush completes, roll back routing rule if latency normalizes, coordinate with CS for affected customers
- escalation: page eng-sre if error-rate > 8% or >5 customers impacted; contact oncall lead (pager: +1-555-0102)

maria: i'll monitor CS tickets and update customer sticky. tagging support inbox and adding status to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.internal/2469998888

sara: ok i'm stepping off for a 20m break — devin will be acting primary during that time. leaving detailed logs in the incident doc. handoff complete. :thumbsup:
